children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Install compatible content from registries, approved URLs, uploads, or IDs while keeping every change reproducible.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: A successful download is not compatibility proof; validate loader, game version, dependencies, startup, and player joins.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: The browser scopes results to game version and loader, then lets you filter provider, category, and popularity.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Confirm game version and loader before searching.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Review provider, author, dependencies, maintenance, and release metadata.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Update checks require a provider and resolvable version.

children.name: Section Title 2
children.text: Install from URL, upload, or ID

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Each source has different provenance, update, allow-list, and manifest behavior.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Use only approved URL hosts and verify the derived filename.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Uploads record provider upload and are never update-checked.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: ID-driven games save selected, added, and removed registry identifiers.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Back up first, confirm the manifest, allow the required restart, and validate events, logs, and player joins. Installs stay inside the server's mods root (v0.4.0).

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Match game + loader + version; choose a trusted source

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  URL may update; upload never auto-updates; IDs persist in manifest

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Backup → save manifest → restart → validate logs and joins

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
